SYMPTOM: All Prisma calls fail with 'No record was found' — user not found, update fails, etc. After fresh DB (restart/migrate), old JWT tokens reference userId from previous DB.
CAUSE: The `jwt` callback in auth.ts only set `token.userId = user.id` when `user` was present (first sign-in trigger). Subsequent requests just returned the cached token with the OLD userId. After DB reset, the user gets a new ID but JWT still has old one.
FIX: In the `jwt` callback, when `user` is not present (subsequent requests), look up the user by `token.email` and update `token.userId`:
```ts
if (!user && token.email) {
  const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: token.email } })
  if (dbUser) token.userId = dbUser.id
}
```
SECONDARY FIX: Change `findUniqueOrThrow` → `findUnique` with graceful fallback in usage.ts and anywhere else that assumes user exists.
AFFECTS: lib/auth.ts jwt callback, lib/usage.ts checkUsage and incrementUsage
